title: Guardsman's experience supports connection to tornado victims
description:
1st Sgt. Michael Treanor lost his parents and step daughter
in the OKC Murrah Building bombing. That experience led 
him to the 63rd Civil Support Team, where he is now a 
first responder for catastrophic events. Available in high definition.
